cues.en: K. Let's turn our attention now to the phone call between Katherine Russell and her husband Tamlin Sarnaev.
cues.zh: K. 现在让我们把注意力转到凯瑟琳·拉塞尔和她丈夫塔梅尔·萨尔纳耶夫之间的通话上。

cues.en: You said something very interesting on Erin Burnett's show last night. You said that if Katherine Russell does not divulge the contents of this phone call, that the FBI had other methods finding out what was said. What did you mean by that?
cues.zh: 你昨晚在艾琳·伯内特的节目里说了件很有意思的事。你说，如果凯瑟琳·拉塞尔不透露这通电话的内容，联邦调查局还有别的办法查明通话说了什么。你这话是什么意思？

cues.en: on the national security, side of the house or in the in the federal government, you know, we have assets. There's lots of assets at our disposal throughout the intelligence community and also not just domestically but overseas.
cues.zh: 在国家安全这一块，或者说联邦政府内部，你知道，我们有很多资源。整个情报系统里有大量资源可供调配，不仅在国内，也在海外。

cues.en: Those assets allow us to gain information and intelligence
cues.zh: 这些资源让我们能够获取情报和信息，

cues.en: on things that we can't use ordinarily in a criminal investigation but are used for major terrorism investigations or counterintelligence investigations. And you're not talking about voicemail.
cues.zh: 这些手段平时不会用在普通的刑事调查中，而是用于重大反恐或反间谍调查。你说的不是语音信箱吧。

cues.en: Right? What are you talking about exactly?
cues.zh: 对吧？那你到底指的是什么？

cues.en: I'm talking about all digital communications are, are,
cues.zh: 我指的是所有的数字通信，

cues.en: there, there's a way to, to look at digital communications in the past,
cues.zh: 其实都有办法调取过往的数字通信记录，

cues.en: and I can't go into detail of how that's done or what's done, but I can tell you that no digital communication is secure, so and these communications will be found out. They will... The conversation will be known, and it's just a question of whether or not Catherine Russell decides to own up to what was said prior to that information being known or after the fact. And if it's... It'll be unfortunate for her if she doesn't own up to it completely and fully because
cues.zh: 具体怎么做、做了什么，我不能细说，但我可以告诉你，没有任何数字通信是绝对安全的，所以这些通信内容一定会被查出来。他们会……通话内容迟早会被知晓，现在唯一的疑问是，Catherine Russell 究竟是打算在这些信息被公之于众之前坦白，还是等东窗事发之后。如果……如果她不彻彻底底全盘托出，对她来说将会非常不利，因为

cues.en: the facts of this case, the facts of her involvement and communication with her husband will be known.
cues.zh: 这个案件的事实，她与丈夫的牵连和沟通情况，都会被查清。
